nombre: Prototipo: fallo de auditoría revierte revocación
sql: SELECT qa.identity(1); SET LOCAL qa.fail_audit='yes'; DO $$ BEGIN BEGIN PERFORM qa.revoke_grant(qa.id(71),qa.id(940)); RAISE EXCEPTION 'FALTA_RECHAZO'; EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '58000' THEN NULL; END; ASSERT (SELECT revoked_at IS NULL FROM clinical.clinical_access_grants WHERE id=qa.id(71)); END $$;
